about: [O6b] The tram on a car (brief O6b §2, O6's left 6): the bed's tram beat, the sedan across the west rails, the tram coming: three seconds and more of shove and sparks (and dents, a door, a bumper) before she burns - O6's half a second; then her fuse and the blast as before. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6b_tram.json

steps.eval: (() => { const v = G.city.cars[2], D = v.smashD; window.__tr.t1 = G.time; window.__tr.parts = { doors: D.doors.filter((d) => d && (d.pivot || d.off)).length, bumpers: D.bumper.filter((b) => b && (b.pivot || b.off)).length, dents: Object.values(D.dents).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) }; return JSON.stringify(window.__tr); })()

steps.label: the tram shoves her three seconds and more (dents) before she burns
the wreck, nobody hurt (me across the road)
